summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds the Update class (prologue, algebra) after Query. rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py imports Update and makes translateUpdate always return an Update container; the prologue is built from q.prologue[0] before the empty-request early exit. The first group is translated once before the exit and again in the loop; this is idempotent. rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py makes evalUpdate iterate update.algebra and documents the container input. rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate beside prepareQuery; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update is unchanged because it already passes the container through. rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. test/test_sparql_prepare.py is new and covers the required cases, including the no-mutation check via (op.name, [str(op)]) snapshots. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the new tests and the existing DAWG and prepareQuery tests are unverified. The INSERT ... WHERE { } initial-bindings test is the most likely to need adjustment once run. The DAWG debug pprintAlgebra call now receives the container; it sits inside try/except. No commits were made.
